gitCommit.subject: feat(items): delete a photo from the item carousel (purses-v1m2) (#227)
gitCommit.body:
feat(items): delete a photo from the item carousel (purses-v1m2) (#227)

* feat(items): delete a photo from the item carousel (purses-v1m2)

Deleting an image already worked, but only behind 'Manage photos' — not where you
look at images. Add a delete control to the item-page carousel so you can remove
the photo you're viewing. New PhotoDeleteControl: trash button -> two-step confirm
('Delete this photo? Keep / Delete', focus to Keep, role=group, idempotency guard)
-> DELETE /api/collections/[id]/items/[itemId]/photos/[photoId]. The carousel goes
stateful so the deleted photo drops out immediately (clamps index; last photo ->
add-photos CTA).

- Unit: PhotoDeleteControl (7) reveal/confirm/focus/double-tap/back-out/non-ok/
  network-reject; carousel (2) drops the photo + falls back to the CTA.
- E2E (real seam): delete the only photo -> real DELETE -> add-photos CTA.

Bead: purses-v1m2

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NpkGzYgcy23jUToNwgjSw9

* fix(items): fold #227 review — permanence copy, permission gate, real-delete proof

- Confirm now states permanence: 'Delete this photo? This can't be undone.' (the
  blob is hard-deleted) + capped panel width so it doesn't obscure the photo [UX major].
- Gate the delete control behind canDeletePhotos||owner: the item page loads the
  membership and passes canDelete; a view-only curator no longer sees a 403-only
  button [UX major]. (PhotoGallery has the same gap — follow-up.)
- Optimistic removal now also router.refresh()es so server-derived bits (promoted
  hero) re-sync [Craftsman minor].
- E2E reloads after delete and asserts no image + the CTA from a SERVER re-fetch —
  proves the row was deleted, not just optimistic state [QA major].
- Tests: gate hides control; middle-photo delete (index shift); owner-sees /
  view-only-hides at the page level. 25 unit + e2e green.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01NpkGzYgcy23jUToNwgjSw9
